work_history.title: Field Service Engineer
work_history.description: Provide on-site installation, troubleshooting, and repair of complex semiconductor equipment. Perform preventive maintenance, modifications, and improvement programs to ensure tool performance. Serve as key liaison with customers, addressing technical and administrative issues efficiently. Coordinate logistics and monitor product performance, providing regular reports and feedback.

work_history.title: Equipment Engineer
work_history.description: Led preventive maintenance planning and execution for Diffusion Module tools. Supervised and trained shift preventive maintenance technicians. Collaborated across departments to drive fab quality, service efficiency, and cost performance. Managed budgets, audits, and external supplier engagements for tool optimisation.

work_history.title: Technical Specialist
work_history.description: Performed tool maintenance, installation, and testing across assigned semiconductor toolsets. Troubleshot mechanical, electrical, and process issues using systematic problem-solving. Improved tool uptime and process stability through SPC monitoring and proactive maintenance. Prepared daily reports and maintained accurate maintenance documentation.

work_history.title: Engineering Specialist
work_history.description: Conducted preventive and corrective maintenance for sputter equipment. Reduced equipment downtime through effective troubleshooting and repair planning. Mentored junior technicians.

work_history.title: Trainer
work_history.description: Planned and conducted training sessions for junior trainers. Ensured training safety and operational readiness.
